other_conditions: First‑time buyers of tractors or farm machinery; applicants must not currently own or have previously owned a tractor or farm machinery in their own name or that of any family member
Eligibility includes all categories of farmers – marginal, small, medium, and large
All Self‑Help Groups (SHGs), cooperative societies, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and entrepreneurs identified by District Nodal Agencies are eligible
Applicants must belong to a group of farmers or be an individual farmer as identified by the district agencies
Facilities for after‑sale service and spare parts must be reasonably available in the implementing area/district
Each beneficiary is required to contribute ₹6.00 lakh per Custom Hiring Centre (CHC)
benefits_summary: Provides subsidized agricultural machinery—including tractors, combine harvesters, power tillers, and other equipment—to eligible farmers and registered farmer groups.
